newsitem.title: UK: Graystone in talks on sale of some units.
newsitem.headline: Graystone in talks on sale of some units.

text.p: Engineering and distribution group Graystone Plc said on Thursday that it is in talks over the sale of some of its engineering businesses.

It said in a statement that its corporate finance director Colin Davies and executive director Patrick Fox have resigned from the company after expressing an interest in buying some of the firm's engineering businesses.
Graystone is also in talks with other parties over the possible sale of these businesses.
By 1131 GMT, shares in Graystone had risen 5p to stand at 74-1/2.
